purpose: Machine-readable handoff for coding/AI agents to organize ventilation data, ThingsBoard mappings, and dashboard views.
important_rules: Use the key field as the canonical application/dashboard key.
PLC engineer must map real PLC variables into the predefined mirror/register block; plc_source fields remain null until confirmed.
Do not treat OPTIONAL fields as guaranteed runtime data.
Do not infer missing/null values as zero.
Fan and pump runtime status uses one variable per device: 0=STOPPED, 1=RUNNING.
Current dashboard integration should remain read-only unless a separate write/control task is explicitly approved.
Mirror mapping in this file is the proposed integration contract; do not silently renumber it.

recommended_states.purpose: Farm/barn overview and summary status. Aggregate values are application-level, not raw PLC variables.
Environmental KPIs, fan/pump running states, inlet positions, operating/control mode and current stage.
Historical trends for environmental and consumption variables.
Read-only monitoring of available PLC alarm flags and platform alarms.
Organize all CÀI ĐẶT groups for display/review. Keep read-only until write semantics are separately approved.
